## What's Changed
* Bring the docs in line with the code, and trim the reference by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/652
* Trim the reference and the plugin API notes, and guard the docs' size by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/654
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.3.2 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/655
* Release 0.18.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/658


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.2...v0.18.3

## What's Changed
* Tree panel: show again where the person opened it, and let a follow finish while sessions work by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/650
* Release 0.18.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/651


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.1...v0.18.2

## What's Changed
* Fix outdated and contradicting statements in the docs and the skill by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/646
* Drop what does not help a human reader from the docs by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/647
* Tree panel: show a session's tree from its root, on follow and on /courier tree by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/648
* Release 0.18.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/649


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.18.0...v0.18.1

## Breaking

- The RPC `summary` output no longer has a `groups` field (#643). A terminal part of 0.16 still open loses its footer until it is restarted. Anyone reading the summary over RPC: drop any use of `groups`.

## Also

- 0.17.0 removed the `/courier memory` command and the memory view along with the rest of memory; its notes did not name them.

## What's Changed
* Mark the shrinking design as implemented by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/636
* Show the sender's title, not its session id, in a courier message's transcript line by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/637
* Design: tools by role (#633) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/638
* Offer a session that cannot start sessions only the tools it can use (#633) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/640
* Record the README demo with the sender's title in the Message from lines by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/642
* Add the /orchestrator-prompt command by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/641
* Remove the empty groups list from the tree summary by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/643
* Name queue among the dropped parameters and settle the shrinking design's open items by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/644
* Release 0.18.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/645


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.17.1...v0.18.0

0.17.1 changes one sentence a model reads. No tool, option or command changes.

## Changed

When a person types into a session that another session started, courier passes the text up to the sessions above it in a notice. That notice says courier cannot tell who sent the text. Sessions above could read this as a reason to overrule the session that received it: to tell it to do its task as first given, or to do the dropped part themselves. The notice now adds, after "acts on it.": "It decides what the text means for its part."

## Also in this version

The real-model checkers (maintainer tooling, not part of what the plugin does at run time) stop accepting what no run can do since 0.17.0: a report held in a join group, a finding sent ahead, a look through `courier_children` and a `courier_recall` call.

## What's Changed
* Shrink 5: remove the real-model checker allowances no run can use, after 0.17.0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/629
* Tell the sessions above that a session decides what typed text means for its part by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/630
* Release 0.17.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/631


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.17.0...v0.17.1
